subject: Re: ABC factor isolation kickoff
body: Status from inside the compute week. Shapes3D grid: ~70% complete and reproducing the paper's core claim — with set supervision on a single shared factor, the ABC objective isolates the complementary factors cleanly; MINE estimates show the isolated representation carrying high mutual information with the target factors and near-zero with the supervised one. The factor-grouping ablations are the interesting product signal: pose/identity-style groupings isolate as well as the easy color factors do. Pose wave starts tomorrow, one day early. Issues: (1) tensorflow_datasets auto-download of Shapes3D failed on the cluster's egress rules — Oyin mirrored it into Corpus, ten-minute fix, noting for the runbook; (2) MINE training is finicky on two factor pairs (estimator variance blows up) — Carmen suggests the standard bias-corrected variant, testing today. No risk to the week's plan. — Giannis
